detail_lineage_keys.usage: Trace cash-receipt detail rows to the cash-receipt header.
Trace cash-disbursement detail rows to the cash-disbursement header.
Trace bank-disbursement detail rows to the bank-disbursement header.
Trace receipt-memo lines to the receipt-memo header.
Trace payment-allocation rows to the receipt-memo header.
Trace send-memo lines to the send-memo header.
Trace payment-allocation rows to the send-memo header.
Trace cash/bank transfer detail rows to the transfer header.
Trace cash/bank transfer allocation rows to the transfer header.
Trace incoming-giro detail rows to the receipt-giro header.
Trace incoming-giro clearing detail rows to the clearing header.
Trace outgoing-giro detail rows to the send-giro header.
Trace outgoing-giro clearing detail rows to the clearing header.
Trace a posted journal back to the source finance document using the source code.

important_rules: Use header tables for document numbers, dates, contacts, accounts, currencies, and total finance values.
Use detail tables for accounts, row-level amounts, memo detail, journal distribution, and transaction detail.
Use _pay tables for memo or transfer allocation so allocation values are not incorrectly taken from headers.
Use _history tables only when the user asks for history, changes, or audit trails.
Distinguish giro documents from giro-clearing documents.
Distinguish manually entered journals from m2_transaction_journal as the posted-journal result table.
Avoid custom* fields unless the user or report explicitly requires them.

query_patterns.name: document_summary
query_patterns.pattern: Use header tables such as m2_cr, m2_cd, m2_bd, m2_rm, m2_sm, m2_rg, m2_sg, m2_gj, m2_aj, or m2_jm for transaction numbers, dates, contacts, and document values.

query_patterns.name: journal_distribution
query_patterns.description: Account distribution per finance document or journal.
query_patterns.pattern: Join headers to detail, for example m2_gj -> m2_gj_detail or m2_cd -> m2_cd_detail.

query_patterns.name: memo_payment_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace memos and their payment allocation.
query_patterns.pattern: Use RM -> RM_DETAIL -> RM_PAY, SM -> SM_DETAIL -> SM_PAY, or CB -> CB_DETAIL -> CB_PAY.

query_patterns.name: giro_clearance_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace giro documents and their clearing.
query_patterns.pattern: Use RG -> RG_DETAIL, RGC -> RGC_DETAIL, SG -> SG_DETAIL, or SGC -> SGC_DETAIL depending on context.

query_patterns.name: posted_journal_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace finance documents to posted transaction journals.
query_patterns.pattern: Connect the source document to m2_transaction_journal using tidtransaksi and tsumber.

caution_areas: Questions that mix memo headers with payment allocation but do not use _pay tables.
Questions about giro that mix giro documents and clearing documents without distinguishing RG/RGC or SG/SGC.
Questions about journals that mix GJ, AJ, JM, and m2_transaction_journal.
History questions that mix active and history tables.
Questions that rely on custom* fields.
